## Developer Guide

If you are new to using `nbdev` here are some useful pointers to get you started.

### Install hongkong_skymaps in Development mode

``` sh
# make sure hongkong_skymaps package is installed in development mode
$ pip install -e .

# make changes under nbs/ directory
# ...

# compile to have changes apply to hongkong_skymaps
$ nbdev_prepare
```

## Usage

### Installation

Install latest from the GitHub [repository](https://github.com/ForBo7/hongkong-skymaps):

``` sh
$ pip install git+https://github.com/ForBo7/hongkong-skymaps.git
```

or from [conda](https://anaconda.org/ForBo7/hongkong-skymaps)

``` sh
$ conda install -c ForBo7 hongkong_skymaps
```

or from [pypi](https://pypi.org/project/hongkong-skymaps/)

``` sh
$ pip install hongkong_skymaps
```

### Documentation

Documentation can be found hosted on this GitHub [repository](https://github.com/ForBo7/hongkong-skymaps)’s [pages](https://ForBo7.github.io/hongkong-skymaps/). Additionally you can find package manager specific guidelines on [conda](https://anaconda.org/ForBo7/hongkong-skymaps) and [pypi](https://pypi.org/project/hongkong-skymaps/) respectively.
